property: budget may be charged only for a message the Mailbox is processing in the current block, whose recipient resolves to the installed module tree, and at most once

test_HistoricalMessagesDrainSurplusByDir.asserts: a message processed in an earlier block cannot be charged

test_CurrentDeliveryChargedExactlyOnce.asserts: a live delivery is charged exactly once

test_SameBlockForeignIsmPathRejected.asserts: a same-block delivery through another module cannot be charged

test_FabricatedMessageRejected.asserts: a message the Mailbox never saw cannot be charged

test_OverBudgetRevertsThenSucceedsAfterR.asserts: an over-budget rejection rolls back and stays replayable
